deadline.value: Recommended deadline for Fall graduate assistantship consideration is February 1.
deadline.quote: The recommended deadline for fall semester graduate assistantship consideration is Feb. 1, although departments/programs may have earlier deadlines.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required but are strongly encouraged.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required but are strongly encouraged.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: During the first semester of study, all students will be assigned an advisory committee.
supervisor.quote: During the first semester of study, all students will be assigned an advisory committee to determine the student’s particular program plan.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships include a monthly stipend and tuition coverage, awarded on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Graduate Assistant Positions: All graduate assistants receive a monthly stipend, and | most cover the cost of tuition.

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold a bachelor's or master's degree in a discipline with an environmental focus.
entry_route.quote: Requirements for Admission: Applicants should hold a bachelor's or master's degree in a discipline with an environmental focus.
